description: Open tour times at one location from CANOPY's live tour calendar, in Pacific time. tour_type is in_person (default), virtual or test_drive. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; the default is the next 7 days, at most 21. If no times are open, the answer lists the alternatives in order: that location's virtual tour, request_tour, and the nearest other location's times (marked as a different location). No contact details needed.
name: get_tour_slots
title: Open tour times at a CANOPY location
